claim: The Weeknd's After Hours Til Dawn 2026 stadium tour plays Lille (Stade Pierre Mauroy, July 3-4), Paris (Stade de France, July 8, 10-12), Amsterdam (Johan Cruijff ArenA, July 16-18), Frankfurt (Deutsche Bank Park, July 30-Aug 1) and Wembley London (Aug 14-19), all within 4-6h of Ghent.

claim: The Weeknd expanded his 2026 European stadium tour to 36 dates with Playboi Carti as main support, the European leg kicking off July 10 at Paris Stade de France.
quote: The Weeknd is extending his 2026 After Hours Til Dawn stadium tour, adding seven additional shows... The 12-date jaunt will kick off on July 10 at Paris' Stade de France

claim: Coldplay's Light Up the Globe 2026 world tour includes Wembley London (July 3), Stade de France Paris (July 7) and Johan Cruyff Arena Amsterdam (July 15), all within 4-6h of Ghent.
quote: July 3, 2026: London, UK – Wembley Stadium; July 7, 2026: Paris, FR – Stade de France; July 15, 2026: Amsterdam, NL – Johan Cruyff Arena

quote: The London shows will take place on 15, 16, 19, 20, 23, 24, 27, 28, 31 August and 1 September 2026... all tickets being sold in 15 minutes

claim: The Weeknd's 2026 European tickets went on general sale 17 October 2025 after presales on 14 October, with Playboi Carti as main support across the stadium run.
quote: Ticket presales will begin on Tuesday (Oct. 14)... before a general sale begins next Friday (Oct. 17)

claim: Dua Lipa has no confirmed 2026 tour dates; her Radical Optimism Tour ended in Mexico City in December 2025 with no new 2026 run announced.
